MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Cheek to Cheek connects with the vocal arrangements I enjoyed in my holiday listening while offering familiar songs beyond Christmas music.",
    "My One And Only Thrill also fits my interest in gentle vocal music, although Cheek to Cheek is the only album I would try this time."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Funk, bluesy rock, instrumental soul, and country collections do not give me the vocal style I want for this session, even if they include familiar songs.",
    "The Phantom of the Opera features singing, but a theatrical cast recording does not meet my current desire for individual vocal songs.",
    "I cannot connect The Definitive Collection to my interests without knowing whose music it contains."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to assume that familiar older music and greatest-hits collections appeal to me regardless of how they sound.",
    "Featuring vocals is not enough by itself; rock singing, country singing, and theatrical performances do not feel interchangeable with the vocal arrangements I want."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent listening suggests that vocal style and arrangements matter more to me right now than whether an album collects well-known songs.",
    "My Christmas albums were chosen together during a holiday listening period; I can enjoy similar vocal warmth without wanting either more Christmas music or unrelated classics.",
    "I rarely choose something unless it feels closely relevant, so finding two appealing albums does not mean I would try both now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly captured my interest in vocal music but stretched that interest too broadly across unrelated styles and familiar-song collections."
}
